- [PREFERENCE] User is weighing the pros and cons of solo travel versus traveling with friends.
- [PREFERENCE] User has experienced both solo travel and group travel before.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on overcoming language barriers and navigating unfamiliar places.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips include learning key phrases, using Google Translate, carrying a phrasebook, asking locals for help, researching beforehand, using online resources, carrying a map, staying alert, using public transportation, and joining a walking tour.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include staying organized, staying connected, and being patient.
- [PREFERENCE] User is thinking about how to stay safe while traveling solo, especially at night.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided advice on staying safe in unfamiliar cities at night.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips include researching the area, planning routes, letting someone know your plans, staying aware of surroundings, sticking to well-lit areas, keeping valuables secure, avoiding distractions, trusting instincts, carrying a safety app, keeping emergency numbers handy, staying sober, using reputable transportation, and being cautious with strangers.
